text:
morgan: Hey team — quick check on the backend panel for candidate #C-472. Can we confirm: 1) panelist arrival times
ravi: I can be there 30 min before (09:00 PT) to go over notes and handoff.
anna: I'll join at 09:10 PT, need to finish another interview at 08:50 so tight but okay.
jun: FYI I'll be remote, dial-in link needed. people-ops-bot: Meeting room booked: Room C, 09:30 PT — dial-in: https://meet.redwood/roomC
morgan: Thanks — can @anna and @jun please confirm reviewer roles (system design / infra / culture) and whether we should use the updated rubric? :eyes:
anna: I'm good to cover system design + performance questions.
jun: I'll do infra and ops. I'll take culture followups if needed.
morgan: Great. People-ops, do we have the latest rubric version? I remember there was a minor change to 'ownership' scoring.
people-ops-bot: Rubric v1.3 uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood/rubrics/interview-engineering-v1.3
ravi: Quick skim — v1.3 changes are just weights: ownership bumped to 20%, communication to 15.
morgan: Can we paste the final scoring breakdown here? small snippet is fine.
anna: Sure, c/p:
```
System design: 30
Ownership: 20
Technical depth: 20
Communication: 15
Culture fit: 15
```
morgan: Perfect. One more — will we ask the candidate to whiteboard during the 45-min system design slot or skip to architecture discussion? I recall last time we ran out of time.
ravi: Recommend no live whiteboard, focus on architecture + tradeoffs. Save time for followups.
jun: Agreed. Also: can someone flag the must-ask question about latency requirements? I want a concrete prompt.
anna: Add: "Design a feature to serve 100 QPS with 200ms P95" — that should surface caching/partitioning tradeoffs.
morgan: Love it. Final ask: can everyone add a 2-line note in the debrief doc immediately after the interview? People-ops, link?
people-ops-bot: Debrief template: https://drive.redwood/debriefs/eng_interview_template
morgan: Thanks all — I'll send final calendar invite with roles and dial-in in 10m :thumbsup:
anna: :thumbsup:
ravi: :thumbsup:
jun: :thumbsup:
